title: ROBOP
abstract: Find where a camera is relative to a robot arm from one photo, for any robot, with no calibration target and no training. ROBOP applies training-free BOP object pose estimators to robot arms, since at a known joint configuration the arm is a rigid object whose geometry follows from its URDF, and evaluates them on six robots under one protocol.
highlight: With refinement, the best generic estimator beats synthetically trained robot-specific models and trails only those fine-tuned on real images, though inference is considerably slower.

demos.alt: Overview of the ROBOP pipeline, in which URDF and joint state become a posed mesh, templates and a detection, which feed NeMO, MegaPose, GigaPose and FoundPose
